name: swornly
receipt_mechanism: HMAC-signed re-verifiable receipt per answer + free /receipts/verify endpoint
description: Deterministic signed-receipt tools; every answer returns an HMAC-signed, re-verifiable receipt. Closest product analogue to Paxiom (testnet).

name: Mycelium Trails
receipt_mechanism: signed trail: payment_hash + action_ref (SHA-256 commitment) + dual-chain anchor (Arbitrum+Base)
description: Post-execution accountability receipts for x402 payments; binds payment to action, verifiable by anyone, for audits/disputes/insurance. Closest conceptual analogue to Paxiom.

name: PayPerByte
receipt_mechanism: EIP-712 PayloadAttestation binds output bytes to signer; buyer re-derives keccak256, fails closed on tamper
description: Every paid response emits an EIP-712 PayloadAttestation binding output to signer; payment-to-output binding primitive.

name: @larkinsh/x402
receipt_mechanism: Ed25519-signed receipts verifiable with only the public key
description: Authorization middleware returning Ed25519-signed receipts; closest to Paxiom's SDK/middleware distribution model.

name: @tensorfeed/x402-base-mcp
receipt_mechanism: verify on-chain that a USDC settlement matches a claimed x402 receipt (recipient+amount)
description: Read-only Base reader purpose-built to verify that a settlement matches a claimed x402 receipt. Direct competitor on the *verification* side.

name: anchor-x402
receipt_mechanism: signed attestations + dual-chain hash anchoring; signed markdown report + anchor proof
description: 16 services incl. signed attestations, dual-chain hash anchoring, verifiable signed RNG, on-chain anchored verdicts.

name: SYNTHORA md-extract
receipt_mechanism: Ed25519 attestation receipt: buyer verifies offline that output came from this mesh untampered
description: Ships an Ed25519 attestation receipt per response - cryptographic chain-of-custody for scraped output. Output-binding analogue.

name: TWZRD Agent Intel
receipt_mechanism: signed twzrd.receipt.v5 trust receipts verifiable offline
description: Signed offline-verifiable trust receipts (versioned receipt schema) - same 'signed receipt as a product' shape as Paxiom.

name: TrustBoost PII Sanitizer
receipt_mechanism: every paid sanitization anchored on Solana via Helius; verify at /verify/{anchor_tx}
description: On-chain proof-of-execution per call, buyer-verifiable at a /verify endpoint. Proof-of-delivery analogue.

name: Kraken Crypto Signals
receipt_mechanism: ECDSA-signed responses + tamper-evident hash-chain track-record
description: Every response ECDSA-signed with a tamper-evident hash-chain; signed-response + integrity-chain analogue.

name: LION
receipt_mechanism: every response Ed25519-attested, verify offline
description: 20 compliance tools, every response Ed25519-attested and offline-verifiable.

name: Stratalize
receipt_mechanism: Ed25519-signed outputs on every synthesis
description: 100+ intelligence tools with Ed25519-signed outputs on every synthesis.

name: AI Growth (verification)
receipt_mechanism: timestamped proof-of-execution receipts (HTTP status, latency, phantom/simulation detection)
description: Sells timestamped proof-of-execution receipts so agents can confirm an A2A service is real before paying. Verification-as-a-service.

name: Agent Passport System (APS)
receipt_mechanism: signed receipts with per-condition attestation; scoped delegation
description: Governance/delegation layer with signed receipts + per-condition attestation.

name: SafeAgent Execution Guard
receipt_mechanism: crash-safe receipts + audit endpoint + audit trail by agent wallet (two-phase PENDING->COMMITTED)
description: Exactly-once execution guard with crash-safe receipts and an audit trail keyed by agent wallet.

name: Boundary Guard
receipt_mechanism: deterministic receipt before downstream writes/sends (allow/retry/block)
description: Pre-action checkpoint returning a deterministic receipt before an agent acts.

name: Voidly Pay
receipt_mechanism: Ed25519-signed envelopes + facilitator-signed quotes + public proof of reserves at /v1/pay/proof
description: Payment rail with Ed25519-signed envelopes, facilitator-signed quotes (anti-MitM) and public proof of reserves.

name: Hive Civilization
receipt_mechanism: verifiable Spectral receipts + ZK attestations across a 52-service fleet
description: 52-service fleet emitting verifiable 'Spectral receipts' plus ZK attestations.

name: LogicNodes
receipt_mechanism: SHA-256 trust hashes on 619 deterministic microservices, 8 chains
description: 619 microservices each returning a SHA-256 trust hash for output integrity.

name: n0brains (/proof)
receipt_mechanism: live auditable per-signal-type win-rate proof at /proof (forward returns, 95% CI)
description: Publishes an auditable per-signal win-rate proof endpoint - provenance/track-record proof.

name: presidio-hardened-x402

description: Pre-signing middleware (fail-closed) over payment metadata; adjacent to receipt-integrity.
